about.text: a range of types of cheese produced especially in the central regions of Italy from the milk of cows, sheep, goats or water buffalo

sources.text: generic Central Italian type, soft yellow rind, short ripening; a dozen-plus regional variants
generic Central Italian type, soft yellow rind, short ripening; a dozen-plus regional variants

facts.v: The Fermano style is eaten young and slightly sweet-sour; the Montefeltro style is aged 2–6 months and more savoury
Aged Montefeltro caciotte (at least 40 days) are stored in barrels, crates or jars lined with walnut leaves
